craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Uprooted-shown-always; palm-grace. Rejected: (a) palm→hand → killed: palm bestows. Read aloud: BY-fear-LESS-ness … BY-palm.

lines: By fearlessness, world-fears uprooted, shown always;
l4.sanskrit_cite: abhayena ca bhavabhayāni unmūlayatā prakāśyate satatam viśvānugrahakāraṇasvabhāvatā tava karatalena

reads_against.argmap: What uproots world-fears? → Fearlessness uproots; grace-nature palmed.
